cat << 'SCRIPT' > /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/scripts/seed0/eval_qwen14b_d050_s0_gsm8k.sh
#!/bin/bash
set -e -x

# C009: evaluate.py md5 verification
EXPECTED_MD5="17673bf373f00f83ccc41fc1d355a4cd"
ACTUAL_MD5=$(md5sum /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ "$ACTUAL_MD5" != "$EXPECTED_MD5" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: evaluate.py md5 mismatch! Expected $EXPECTED_MD5, got $ACTUAL_MD5"
  exit 1
fi

# C004: explicit CUDA device
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python
EVAL=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py
CKPT=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B

# Adapter path auto-detection
ADAPTER_BASE="$CKPT/Qwen2.5-14B_d050_s0"
if [ -f "${ADAPTER_BASE}/lora_adapter/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    ADAPTER="${ADAPTER_BASE}/lora_adapter"
elif [ -f "${ADAPTER_BASE}/adapter_config.json" ]; then
    ADAPTER="${ADAPTER_BASE}"
else
    echo "ERROR: adapter not found at ${ADAPTER_BASE}"
    exit 1
fi

# C006: verify lora_alpha=32
ALPHA=$(grep -o '"lora_alpha": [0-9]*' "$ADAPTER/adapter_config.json" | grep -o '[0-9]*')
if [ "$ALPHA" != "32" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: lora_alpha=$ALPHA (expected 32)"
    exit 1
fi

OUT_DIR="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/results/gsm8k_eval/qwen14b/d050_s0"
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

echo "=== START: qwen14b_d050_s0_gsm8k at $(date) ==="
$PYTHON $EVAL \
    --model-path "$MODEL" \
    --adapter-path "$ADAPTER" \
    --benchmarks gsm8k \
    --batch-size 2 \
    --output-dir "$OUT_DIR"
echo "=== DONE: qwen14b_d050_s0_gsm8k at $(date), exit=$? ==="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/scripts/seed0/eval_qwen14b_d050_s0_gsm8k.sh
